effective_n: number of eligible unique dependency_cluster_id values in the relevant development or sealed-confirmatory population

model_unit.definition: An independently initialized training run before learned-state ancestry and teacher/merge dependencies are clustered.
model_unit.note: Independent initialization can create a distinct model_unit_id but does not prevent clustering through a teacher, base, merge, or inherited learned state.

measurement_unit: (model revision, task, base-case orbit, decoding configuration)
pilot_balance: OSS-1 assigns exactly three dependency clusters. Each contains one semantic_anchor, one surface_cue_anchor, and one mixed_anchor under a shared architecture family and tokenizer, for nine model units total. Effective n remains three, not nine.
prohibited_n_inflation: counting checkpoints from one training run as independent
counting fine-tunes or adapters from one base as independent
counting prompts, cases, templates, samples, or responses as independent models
placing a teacher, base, merge parent, or shared-weight descendant across train and test

uncertainty.within_model_precision: case or pair resampling may be reported separately and must not be labeled population uncertainty
uncertainty.three_cluster_policy: descriptive pilot intervals only; no population-level confidence claim

claim_ceiling.pilot: Three dependency clusters support named-unit engineering evidence only.
claim_ceiling.confirmatory: Fresh outcome-naive execution with at least three development and three sealed-confirmatory clusters, subject to frozen power analysis.

ancestry_evidence_boundary: Cluster closure is machine-checked against the content-addressed parent inventory supplied by the declared authority. It does not prove that an omitted or unknowable external dependency does not exist; incomplete or ambiguous provenance must be conservatively clustered or excluded.
missing_or_ambiguous_ancestry: Treat affected units as one conservative dependency cluster or abstain from a cross-cluster claim.
